units.source_text: 阿泷伸了伸腰，依然蹲在水沟上，凝望着城里人所说的“秋天”的景象。

en.t: Ataki stretched her back, still squatting over the ditch, gazing at the scene that city people called autumn.

units.source_text: 然而……月色下，仅仅浮现出故乡的山脉。

en.t: And yet, in the moonlight, only the mountains of her hometown rose into view.

units.source_text: 她即使进了城，也不会记起温泉乡这溪谷的流水声。

en.t: Even if she went into the city, she would not remember the sound of the stream in this hot spring village valley.

units.source_text: 月光透过栎树叶，洒落在五个月都没休息玩耍的她那鼓鼓的肚皮上，好像是斑马的样子。

en.t: Moonlight filtered through the oak leaves and fell on her swollen belly, the belly of someone who had gone five months without rest or play, making it look like a zebra.
